historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; captures a declared count label but does not enumerate descriptors or validate x-by-y table bounds.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds count/list/length validation but lowers capability for pending descriptor policy inputs.
historical_reviews.round_02: No exact-code Round 02 record was found in the repository search.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Verify the Type 15 descriptor count x matches the approved number of supported event-log type descriptors, exactly matches the table that fits within the formatted structure using descriptor length y, and persists after reboot.
original_method: Capture raw Type 15 structure length, x, y and descriptor bytes; compute the descriptor-table span, enumerate exactly x entries without crossing bounds, compare count/content policy and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves descriptor count/table expectations and reboot plan. No log mutation or unknown descriptor content parsing is needed to validate structural integrity.
required_inputs: Expected descriptor count x or approved descriptor inventory
Expected descriptor length y and version-specific descriptor format
Handling for zero count, OEM/unknown event types and multiple records
Raw-capable parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read raw Type 15 metadata only; do not clear/write/inject event logs.
Preserve x, y and formatted length and perform overflow-safe table-span arithmetic before enumerating.
Do not read beyond structure bounds or infer missing descriptor bytes from decoded labels.
A zero count must be evaluated against platform policy and table length, not automatically accepted or rejected.
Stop on count/list mismatch, truncated/extra table, unsupported format or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Extract x/y/structure length, validate table-span arithmetic, enumerate exact descriptor boundaries and compare count/table policy pre/post reboot.
Do not parse unknown descriptor payload beyond safe boundaries, mutate logs or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected count/table and OEM/zero handling.
Approve reboot/recovery, supply custom descriptor definitions where required and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The declared count is relevant, but the grep may not match decoder wording and cannot prove x descriptors of length y fit or are present.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw/decoded Type 15 data and report formatted length, x, y, computed table span, enumerated entry count and any remainder/truncation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The descriptor count x scope, Type 15 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use raw length-aware parsing to calculate descriptor table bounds from x and y, enumerate exactly x entries and compare declared/actual count and approved descriptor inventory across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 15 records containing supported log type descriptors.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, descriptor-format and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 15 descriptor count/length/table layout, approved platform descriptor policy and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces isolated count text with overflow-safe count-length-bound and actual-entry validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage for truncated, extra, zero-length and mismatched descriptor tables.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected x/y/table policy and descriptor definitions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Structural descriptor support does not prove actual log records of each event type exist or decode correctly.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a different descriptor inventory for a firmware release, but must version x, y and the full list together; structural count/list consistency cannot be overridden away.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/firmware identity, expected x/y/table and OEM handling
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 15 structure with formatted length, x, y and descriptor bytes
Overflow-safe table-span, declared/enumerated count, remainder and truncation results
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot structure/table diff without clearing logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The descriptor count field has clear structural semantics when evaluated with y and structure length.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Count/table integrity is safely automatable; custom descriptor meaning may remain a project input without blocking structural review.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw x/y, table bounds and actual enumeration.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains format/bounds safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates OEM descriptor definitions and engineer verdict from core structural capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a correct count byte from passing when the descriptor table is truncated, oversized or uses an invalid zero length.
independent_technical_reasoning: x, y and structure length define a deterministic bounded table; safe arithmetic and entry enumeration are fully automatable.
